Welcome to **Lost in Asia EP 6 🇻🇳 | Vietnam Travel Series!**

In this episode, I travel from **Ho Chi Minh City to Da Nang by flight** to explore one of Vietnam’s most famous attractions — the incredible **Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills**, supported by two giant stone hands! 😱

Join me on this exciting Vietnam travel journey as I explore the following places:

✈️ **Ho Chi Minh City to Da Nang Flight Journey**
🏞️ **Golden Bridge (Cau Vang)** – The iconic bridge held by giant stone hands
🏰 **Ba Na Hills French Village** – European-style architecture, beautiful streets, and amazing views
🌄 **Ba Na Hills** – Scenic mountain views and a memorable travel experience

If you are planning a trip to Vietnam and looking for the best places to visit in Da Nang, this Telugu travel vlog will give you a glimpse of the Golden Bridge, Ba Na Hills, and the French Village.

Watch till the end to experience this beautiful destination with me!

🌏 **LOST IN ASIA – EPISODE 6**

I am exploring amazing destinations across Asia and sharing my travel experiences, flight journeys, tourist attractions, local food, and useful travel information.

👍 Like this video if you enjoy international travel.
💬 Comment below: Would you visit the Golden Bridge in Vietnam?
